description: Inherited house: declare at the official price (기준시가) or an appraisal (감정평가)? The declared value becomes the acquisition cost when the heir sells (소득세법 시행령 제163조⑨), so a low value cuts inheritance tax but raises later capital gains tax. Computes inheritance tax (lump-sum 500M, spouse 500M-3B, appraisal fee up to 5M deducted, 3% filing credit, 10-50%) plus capital gains tax on a later sale (heir has another house, no surcharge; long-term deduction from the inheritance date) for both values and returns the cheaper choice.
